conclusion: Combined-only heuristic training remained brittle; removing shaping modestly improved mean, while defense-biased shaping did not. Policy mixture changed versus prior historical groups, limiting cross-group causal comparisons.

runs.goal_hypothesis: Establish a combined-heuristic training baseline with coefficient-0.01 potential shaping.

results_insights.insight: Combined-policy wins were 9% as X and 0% as O.
Combined-X games lasted 9.97 moves on average.

reasoning: The shaped combined regimen did not learn robust combined-policy play.
This first group run defines both opponent mix and shaping, so cross-era causality is limited.
Per-side 100-game evaluations expose substantial sampling and seed uncertainty.

runs.goal_hypothesis: Remove shaping while holding the combined-heuristic regimen fixed relative to be3f7f8e3c60490184b9c1b113b6d1e7.

results_insights.insight: No shaping improved aggregate win rate by 0.035.
Combined-X performance fell from 9% to 3%, with O still zero.
The weak combined-X games lasted 7.18 moves on average.
Aggregate gain came partly from stronger defensive-policy evaluation.
The defensive-X evaluation lasted 21.86 moves on average.

reasoning: Removing shaping modestly improved aggregate performance but not the target combined opponent.
The coefficient-only configuration delta makes this the cleanest group comparison.
Stochastic training may account for small changes, while policy-specific shifts warn against aggregate-only conclusions.

runs.goal_hypothesis: Test defense-biased shaping against the unshaped combined-heuristic control b8fffa7e72024d0b954d4aed9fd84c85.

results_insights.insight: Defense-biased shaping was worst of the three aggregate outcomes.
It won no combined-policy games on either side.
The winless combined-X games lasted 8.07 moves on average.
Longer defensive-O games still yielded only 5% wins.

reasoning: Defense-biased shaping degraded the target combined-policy outcome.
Coefficient and defense weight changed together versus control, so their effects cannot be separated.
Run-to-run stochasticity remains a caveat, though zero combined wins is strong negative evidence.
